name: Prince Pipes and Fittings Limited
summary: Prince Pipes and Fittings Limited manufactures and sells piping solutions in India. The company offers the SMARTFIT PLUS chlorinated polyvinyl chloride (CPVC) hot and cold potable water plumbing systems, EASYFIT unplasticized polyvinyl chloride (UPVC) plumbing systems, and EASYFIT RE reclaim piping systems; Onefit Corzan CPVC industrial piping system, GREENFIT poly propylene random copolymer (PPR) plumbing and industrial piping systems, GREENFIT BLUE PPR industrial piping systems; and Skolan Safe polypropylene (PP) drainage system.
